title: Diamond Elite Card: Invitation Promo Offer - Spend and Earn Rewards
summary: This document describes the Diamond Elite Card invitation promo offer (2025-11-01 to 2026-01-31) requiring $50,000 in eligible purchases within 1 month after your account opens. If qualified, the $495 annual fee is waived and a $5,000 statement credit is applied after review (allow one billing cycle).
